purpose: Si64 calibration to CP2K cpFIT3 EPS_SCHWARZ=1e-6 PBE-restart absolute energy bias; fixed c_IP scaling.
selection_rule: Among converged integer c_IP=1..30 cases, maximize absolute Si64 error subject to error <= CP2K target. Break ties by smaller c_IP.
timing_definition: Kylin-PBC main timer; CP2K PBE plus HSE total. Process wall and maximum RSS are also retained.
reference_definition: Kylin vs same-binary, same-grid FTDF; CP2K vs its existing no-ADMM EPS6 control. These isolate acceleration approximations, not complete physical-method errors.
historical_caveats: The frozen current binary uses fused TILE and differs from the historical paper executable; historical timing differences cannot be attributed only to c_IP.
Historical Si256 uses dropG0=OFF/exxdiv=NONE; this new series consistently uses ON/EWALD, matching Si64 calibration.
Historical CP2K Si16 ADMM used SCREEN_ON_INITIAL_P=FALSE; other sizes used TRUE.
Matching at Si64 does not establish matched error at other sizes.
